fields.location: Karun City sub-office and video link

items.discussion: No health partner has reported in Hadar. Two partners said they could cover it only with new funding. Agreed to escalate to the Humanitarian Country Team.
Need is about 40 operations a day; capacity is about 15. Kestrel Health Aid offered one team from 17 October.
Two district stores lost power. The logistics cluster will report on generators by 16 October.

actions.action: Kestrel Health Aid to confirm a trauma team for Soma Valley
Cluster coordinator to ask the Humanitarian Country Team for a partner in Hadar
Information management officer to add Karun East to the 3W reporting form
